caption: The drawing depicts a large, lidded tankard or stein, rendered in pencil or graphite on a light beige background. The tankard has a cylindrical body with a slightly flared base and features a domed lid with a central raised section and a small finial. The handle is large and ornate, curving outward and downward, terminating in a lion's head design at the lower end. The thumb rest on top of the handle is also decorated with an elaborate scrollwork pattern. The spout of the tankard is wide and inset, with a beaded edge. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch of the same tankard enclosed in a square, showing the object in profile with key compositional details highlighted. The shading on the main tankard illustration suggests a metallic, reflective surface. The drawing is contained within a faintly outlined rectangular border.
title: Silver Tankard
